notes: The three prepositional attributive articles are decided by position under rule 31: s013 and s041 follow their nouns and keep only *that*, while s019 precedes δοκόν and takes the discontinuous *the … that* headed on *the*.
The supplied *own* at t032 and t044 is a rule 7 helper on σοῦ; no ἴδιος stands in this verse, so rule 47 is not in question.
